newsitem.title: UK: Babcock's Rosyth to get naval refit work.
newsitem.headline: Babcock's Rosyth to get naval refit work.

text.p: The government said it had allocated "a significant programme of ship refit work" to the Rosyth naval dockyard, which Babcock International Group Plc announced earlier on Monday it had agreed to acquire.
Defence Procurement Minister James Arbuthnot said in a written parliamentary answer the work would last well into the next decade.
It would include refits of the Royal Navy's Invincible and Ark Royal carriers and Sceptre and Spartan nuclear-powered submarines.
Arbuthnot gave few other details of the agreement with Babcock.
But he said: "That agreement represents good value for money for the taxpayer and will generate savings of 100 million stg over 10 years.
"It will also give Babcock and its employees the prospect of achieving a secure long-term future for the dockyard." -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
